blurb: Guests sail aboard the Liberty, a 41-foot Friendship Sloop replica, with a maximum of six guests per trip. The experience is wind-powered sailing with the engine off when possible, led by Captain Phil, who has over 50 years of sailing experience and is present on every departure. Tours include afternoon sails, sunset cruises, and private charters, with all-inclusive pricing covering drinks and snacks.

quotes.author: Sarah & Michael
quotes.text: The most beautiful boat on San Diego Bay! Captain Phil’s passion for sailing is infectious. We learned so much about traditional sailing while enjoying wine.

quotes.author: Robert
quotes.text: As a lifelong sailor, I appreciated the authenticity. This is REAL sailing—no motor-sailing, proper sail trim. The Liberty is beautifully maintained!

quotes.author: The Martinez Family
quotes.text: Perfect family experience! Our kids loved steering the boat and learning about sailing. Captain Phil was patient and made everyone feel comfortable.

quotes.author: David
quotes.text: I proposed to my girlfriend on the Liberty at sunset, and Captain Phil helped make it perfect. She said yes! Unforgettable experience.
